card.name: Just before strong negative adjectives
card.fires_on: Small words and quote marks right before an expected harsh or emphatic adjective, such as vile, odious, blatant or valuable. Mostly in historical or literary prose about accusations and insults.

modes.label: Insult setup
modes.description: A quote mark, article or part of an insult word just before a harsh label like vile liar or odious viper.
modes.example: Martino calls Ines a<< ">>vile liar, an odious viper

modes.label: Linking word before evaluation
modes.description: A word like of, to be or most that leads into an emphatic descriptive adjective.
modes.example: This proves those communist slogans to<< be>> blatant bare-faced lies.

card.writes: It promotes words like infinitely, unw and merit, which suggests it prepares for an intensifying or evaluative adjective.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a strongly judging adjective, such as in an insult or accusation.
